versions.changelog:
- Initial release of dongdaemun-sourcing skill for wholesale fashion sourcing at Dongdaemun market, Seoul.
- Integrates with apMZoomAI tools to search products, find new arrivals, and locate stalls.
- Supports requests in eight languages: English, Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Vietnamese, Thai, Indonesian, and Malay.
- Presents concise item and stall information with apMZoomAI detail links.
- Enforces rules: no prices, no contact details, no stall endorsements, and no purchase prompts.
